remarks:
Rare 4-Unit Investment Opportunity in Cheektowaga!

Great opportunity to own a well-maintained four-unit property conveniently located just minutes from the Thruway entrance and within the Cleveland Hill School District. Each of the four side-by-side apartments features an identical layout, offering 2 bedrooms, comfortable living space, and private laundry hookups.

The property features separate utilities for each unit, making it an attractive option for investors looking for manageable operating expenses. All four units are currently occupied by solid, long-term tenants, with month-to-month tenancies, and the tenants would like to remain—providing an opportunity for a new owner to step into an established income-producing property.

Numerous updates have been completed over the years. Improvements by previous ownership in 2012 included vinyl siding, windows, several furnaces and hot water tanks, doors, kitchens, sinks, and the garage door. The current owners have continued to maintain and improve the property, including installation of a newer metal roof and gutters. The garage roof was replaced just a few years ago, and the bathrooms in Units 24A and 24B have been updated. An additional 1-car garage provides another income opportunity

Whether you're an experienced investor looking to add a solid four-unit property to your portfolio or an owner-occupant looking to live in one unit while rental income helps offset your mortgage, this property offers flexibility, established tenants, separate utilities, and convenient location.

Four units. Eight total bedrooms. Established rental income. Excellent location. Great investment potential!
